bounded_host_request.command:
set -euo pipefail
db="$(docker ps --filter label=com.docker.compose.project=deploy --filter label=com.docker.compose.service=postgres --format '{{.Names}}' | head -1)"
test -n "$db"
sql="BEGIN;
DO \$\$ DECLARE n INTEGER; BEGIN
 SELECT COUNT(*) INTO n FROM posting_topics
 WHERE purpose='announcement' AND enabled=TRUE AND verified_by IS NOT NULL AND verified_at IS NOT NULL
 AND title LIKE '%みんなのプロフ%'
 AND ((board_key='video_chat' AND chat_id=-1002373696859 AND message_thread_id=1613)
 OR (board_key='gay_board' AND chat_id=-1003770334893 AND message_thread_id=210));
 IF n<>2 THEN RAISE EXCEPTION 'PROFILE_SOURCE_TOPICS_NOT_VERIFIED'; END IF;
END \$\$;
INSERT INTO posting_topics(board_key,purpose,chat_id,message_thread_id,title,verified_by,verified_at,enabled)
SELECT board_key,'profile',chat_id,message_thread_id,title,verified_by,verified_at,TRUE FROM posting_topics
WHERE purpose='announcement' AND enabled=TRUE AND verified_by IS NOT NULL AND verified_at IS NOT NULL
AND title LIKE '%みんなのプロフ%'
AND ((board_key='video_chat' AND chat_id=-1002373696859 AND message_thread_id=1613)
OR (board_key='gay_board' AND chat_id=-1003770334893 AND message_thread_id=210))
ON CONFLICT (board_key,purpose,chat_id,message_thread_id) DO NOTHING;
COMMIT;
SELECT 'PROFILE_DESTINATION='||board_key||':'||chat_id||':'||message_thread_id FROM posting_topics WHERE purpose='profile' AND enabled=TRUE ORDER BY board_key;"
out="$(docker exec "$db" psql -U gace -d gaybbs -A -t -v ON_ERROR_STOP=1 -c "$sql")"
{ echo 'PR47_PROFILE_DESTINATIONS_VERIFIED_IMPORT'; printf '%s\n' "$out"; printf 'BOT_RUNNING=%s\n' "$(docker inspect --format '{{.State.Running}}' deploy-gaybbs-1)"; } | gh issue comment 4 --repo seigo-gace/GateApp-Bot --body-file - >/dev/null
